description: This file defines an enum 'ExecApprovalCommandDisplaySanitizer' that provides static methods to sanitize strings by escaping invisible or formatting Unicode characters, primarily for display purposes.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes a string by escaping invisible or formatting Unicode characters.

methods.name: shouldEscape
methods.description: Determines if a UnicodeScalar should be escaped based on its general category or if it is an invisible code point.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Converts a UnicodeScalar into its escaped string representation.
